name: CustomControl
description: When setting the properties of an ActiveX control, you may need or prefer to use the control's custom properties dialog box. This custom properties dialog box provides an alternative to the list of properties in the Microsoft Access property sheet for setting ActiveX control properties in Design view.
remarks: The reason for the custom properties dialog box is that not all applications that use ActiveX controls provide a property sheet like the one in Microsoft Access. The custom properties dialog box provides an interface for setting key control properties regardless of the interface supplied by the hosting application. For some ActiveX control properties, you can choose either of these two locations to set the property: - The Microsoft Access property sheet. - The ActiveX control's custom properties dialog box. In some cases, the custom properties dialog box is the only way to set a property in Design view. This is usually the situation when the interface needed to set a property doesn't work inside the Microsoft Access property sheet. For example, the GridFont property for the Calendar control has a number of arguments; you can't set more than one argument per property in the Microsoft Access property sheet. Not all ActiveX controls provide a custom properties dialog box. To see whether a control provides this custom properties dialog box, look for the Custom property in the Microsoft Access property sheet for this control.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Use the Application property to access the active Microsoft Access Application object and its related properties. Read-only Application object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: OldValue
properties.description: Use the OldValue property to determine the unedited value of a bound control. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: Object
properties.description: Use the Object property in Visual Basic to return a reference to the ActiveX object that is associated with a linked or embedded OLE object in a control. By using this reference, you can access the properties or invoke the methods of the OLE object. Read-only Object.

properties.name: ObjectVerbs
properties.description: Use the ObjectVerbs property in Visual Basic to determine the list of verbs that an OLE object supports. Read-only String.

properties.name: Properties
properties.description: Returns a reference to a control's Properties collection object. Read-only.

properties.name: Controls
properties.description: Returns the Controls collection of a form, subform, report, or section. Read-only Controls.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: Gets or sets the value displayed in the specified control. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: EventProcPrefix
properties.description: Gets or sets the prefix portion of an event procedure name. Read/write String.

properties.name: ControlType
properties.description: Use the ControlType property in Visual Basic to determine the type of control on a form or report. Read/write Byte.

properties.name: ControlSource
properties.description: Use the ControlSource property to specify what data appears in a control. You can display and edit data bound to a field in a table, query, or SQL statement. You can also display the result of an expression. Read/write String.

properties.name: OLEClass
properties.description: Use the OLEClass property to obtain a description of the kind of OLE object contained in a chart control or an unbound object frame. Read-only String.

properties.name: Verb
properties.description: Use the Verb property to specify the operation to perform when an OLE object is activated, which is permitted when the control's Action property is set to acOLEActivate. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Class
properties.description: Use the Class property to specify or determine the class name of an embedded OLE object. Read/write String.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: Returns or sets whether the object is visible. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayWhen
properties.description: Use the DisplayWhen property to specify which of a form's controls you want displayed on screen and in print. Read/write Byte.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.description: Use the Enabled property to set or return the status of the conditional format in the FormatCondition object. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Locked
properties.description: The Locked property specifies whether you can edit data in a control in Form view. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: TabStop
properties.description: Use the TabStop property to specify whether you can use the Tab key to move the focus to a control. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: TabIndex
properties.description: Use the TabIndex property to specify a control's place in the tab order on a form or report. Read/write Integer.

properties.name: Left
properties.description: Use the Left property to specify an object's location on a form or report. Read/write Integer.

properties.name: Top
properties.description: Use the Top property to specify an object's location on a form or report. Read/write Integer.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Gets or sets the width of the specified object in twips. Read/write Integer.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Gets or sets the height of the specified object in twips. Read/write Integer.

properties.name: SpecialEffect
properties.description: Use the SpecialEffect property to specify whether special formatting will apply to the specified object. Read/write Byte.

properties.name: BorderStyle
properties.description: Specifies how a control's border appears. Read/write Byte.

properties.name: OldBorderStyle
properties.description: Use this property to set or return the unedited value of the BorderStyle property for a form or control. This property is useful if you need to revert to an unedited or preferred border style. Read/write Byte.

properties.name: BorderColor
properties.description: Use the BorderColor property to specify the color of a control's border. Read/write Long.

properties.name: BorderWidth
properties.description: Use the BorderWidth property to specify the width of a control's border. Read/write Byte.

properties.name: ControlTipText
properties.description: Use the ControlTipText property to specify the text that appears in a ScreenTip when you hold the mouse pointer over a control. Read/write String.

properties.name: HelpContextId
properties.description: The HelpContextID property specifies the context ID of a topic in the custom Help file specified by the HelpFile property setting. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Section
properties.description: You can identify these controls by the section of a form or report where the control appears. Read/write Integer.

properties.name: Tag
properties.description: Stores extra information about a form, report, section, or control needed by a Microsoft Access application. Read/write String.

properties.name: ObjectPalette
properties.description: The ObjectPalette property specifies the palette in the application used to create an OLE object. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: ObjectVerbsCount
properties.description: Use the ObjectVerbsCount property in Visual Basic to determine the number of verbs supported by an OLE object. Read-only Long.

properties.name: IsVisible
properties.description: Use the IsVisible property to determine whether a control on a report is visible. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: InSelection
properties.description: Use the InSelection property to determine or specify whether a control on a form in Design view is selected. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: OnUpdated
properties.description: Sets or returns the value of the On Updated box in the Properties window of a form or report. Read/write String.

properties.name: OnEnter
properties.description: Sets or returns the value of the On Enter box in the Properties window of specified object. Read/write String.

properties.name: OnExit
properties.description: Sets or returns the value of the On Exit box in the Properties window of specified object. Read/write String.

properties.name: OnGotFocus
properties.description: Sets or returns the value of the On Got Focus box in the Properties window of the specified object. Read/write String.

properties.name: OnLostFocus
properties.description: Sets or returns the value of the On Lost Focus box in the Properties window of the specified object. Read/write String.

properties.name: Default
properties.description: Use the Default property to specify whether a command button is the default button on a form. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Cancel
properties.description: Use the Cancel property to specify whether a command button is also the Cancel button on a form. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Custom
properties.description: Returns or sets a String representing the custom properties dialog box for an ActiveX control. Read/write.

properties.name: About
properties.description: Returns or sets a String representing version and copyright information for an ActiveX control. Read/write.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Use the Name property to specify or determine the string expression that identifies the name of an object. Read/write String.

properties.name: BorderThemeColorIndex
properties.description: Gets or sets a value that represents a color in the applied color theme associated with the BorderColor property of the specified object. Read/write Long.

properties.name: BorderTint
properties.description: Gets or sets the tint that is applied to the theme color in the BorderColor property of the specified object. Read/write Single.

properties.name: BorderShade
properties.description: Gets or sets the shade that is applied to the theme color in the BorderColor property of the specified object. Read/write Single.

properties.name: Layout
properties.description: Returns the type of layout for the specified control. Read-only AcLayoutType.

properties.name: LeftPadding
properties.description: Gets or sets the amount of space (in inches) between the control and its left gridline. Read/write Integer.

properties.name: TopPadding
properties.description: Gets or sets the amount of space (in inches) between the control and its top gridline. Read/write Integer.

properties.name: RightPadding
properties.description: Gets or sets the amount of space (in inches) between the control and its right gridline. Read/write Integer.

properties.name: BottomPadding
properties.description: Gets or sets the amount of space (in inches) between the control and its bottom gridline. Read/write Integer.

properties.name: GridlineStyleLeft
properties.description: Gets or sets the left gridline style of the specified control. Read/write Byte.

properties.name: GridlineStyleTop
properties.description: Gets or sets the top gridline style of the specified control. Read/write Byte.

properties.name: GridlineStyleRight
properties.description: Gets or sets the right gridline style of the specified control. Read/write Byte.

properties.name: GridlineStyleBottom
properties.description: Gets or sets the bottom gridline style of the specified control. Read/write Byte.

properties.name: GridlineWidthLeft
properties.description: Gets or sets the width of the left gridline for the specified control. Read/write Byte.

properties.name: GridlineWidthTop
properties.description: Gets or sets the width of the top gridline for the specified control. Read/write Byte.

properties.name: GridlineWidthRight
properties.description: Gets or sets the width of the right gridline for the specified control. Read/write Byte.

properties.name: GridlineWidthBottom
properties.description: Gets or sets the width of the bottom gridline for the specified control. Read/write Byte.

properties.name: GridlineColor
properties.description: Gets or sets the color of the gridline for the specified control. Read/write Long.

properties.name: HorizontalAnchor
properties.description: Gets or sets an AcHorizontalAnchor constant that indicates how the control is anchored horizontally within its layout. Read/write.

properties.name: VerticalAnchor
properties.description: Gets or sets an AcVerticalAnchor constant that indicates how the specified control is anchored vertically within its layout. Read/write.

properties.name: LayoutID
properties.description: Returns the unique identifier for the layout that contains the specified control. Read-only Long.

properties.name: VarOleObject
properties.description: Gets a pointer to an IOLEObject that represents the memory address of an OLE object. Read-only Variant.

methods.name: SizeToFit
methods.description: Use the SizeToFit method to size a control so that it fits the text or image that it contains.

methods.name: Requery
methods.description: The Requery method updates the data underlying a specified control that's on the active form by requerying the source of data for the control.

methods.name: SetFocus
methods.description: The SetFocus method moves the focus to the specified form, the specified control on the active form, or the specified field on the active datasheet.

methods.name: Move
methods.signature: Move(Left As Variant, [Top As Variant], [Width As Variant], [Height As Variant])
methods.description: Moves the specified object to the coordinates specified by the argument values.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The screen position in twips for the left edge of the object relative to the left edge of the Microsoft Access window.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The screen position in twips for the top edge of the object relative to the top edge of the Access window.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The desired width of the object in twips.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The desired height of the object in twips.

events.name: Updated
events.description: The Updated event occurs when an OLE object's data has been modified.

events.name: Enter
events.description: The Enter event occurs before a control actually receives the focus from a control on the same form or report.

events.name: Exit
events.description: The Exit event occurs just before a control loses the focus to another control on the same form or report.

parameters.name: Cancel
parameters.description: Set to True to cancel the event.

events.name: GotFocus
events.description: The GotFocus event occurs when the specified object receives the focus.

events.name: LostFocus
events.description: The LostFocus event occurs when the specified object loses the focus.
